author: Love of a Mother
content:
The kids had so much fun it was unreal!
I remember nothing except hearing shrieks of laughter and cartoon sounds effects haha!
We played NO party games except tidy the balls because they were all so engrossed in the soft play!
Thank you so much for your patience with my constant messages and changes. The speed the two of you put the equipent up and took it down was out of this world! The equipment was also so clean and fresh, not worn at all as I have seen in the past.
Dancing cubs honestly made my party!
Thank you!!
